newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy economic plan (DPEF) seen ready next May 22.
newsitem.headline: Italy economic plan (DPEF) seen ready next May 22.

text.p: Italy's latest three year programme of economic targets (DPEF) will probably be released to the Senate (upper house) next Thursday, the leader of the Senate budget committee said.
The eagerly awaited DPEF is expected to give indications of savings the government hopes to make from a planned reform of the welfare state. It will also give new 1998 deficit forecasts.
"I expect the DPEF next week, probably Thursday," the budget committee's Romualdo Coviello told reporters.

Newspapers reported that the key Treasury document might be handed to Prime Minister Romano Prodi this weekend, He is expected to take some days studying the forecasts before making it publicly available.
Coviello said the budget committees of the two house of parliament would take around three weeks to debate the document before passing it for approval to the upper and lower chambers.
"The main part of the DPEF will concern the reform of the welfare state and we will pay particular attention to this aspect," Coviello said.

Prime Minister Romano Prodi started talks with unions this week over welfare reform, with the government eager to introduce structural spending cuts to enhance its credentials for membership of the single European currency. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
